name: Gan'rul Bloodeye
summary: In Orgrimmar, Gan'rul Bloodeye trains warlocks beneath the city. In the Cleft of Shadow, Horde initiates learn darker demonic rites and how to bend voidwalkers and succubi to their will.

sections.title: A Master in the Shadows
sections.body: Warlocks study out of sight in the Cleft of Shadow beneath Orgrimmar. Warchief Thrall tolerates them in the new Horde, though Durotar's open sunlight is no place for their dark arts. The cavern gives shadow weavers, rogues, and fel casters room to study unmolested. From there, Gan'rul teaches rising practitioners of fel magic.

sections.title: Binding the Nether
sections.body: Ambitious warlocks come to Gan'rul to learn dangerous summoning rites. Those seeking to bind a greater demon, such as a resilient voidwalker or a seductive succubus, must secure ritual components and learn the precise incantations. The summoned creature must be dominated before it consumes its master.

faq.answer: Gan'rul Bloodeye trains orc warlocks in Orgrimmar. He mentors novice and intermediate Horde warlocks in summoning and binding demons from the Twisting Nether.

faq.q: Where can I find Gan'rul Bloodeye?
aliases: where is cleft of shadow trainer
faq.answer: Find Gan'rul in the Cleft of Shadow, a cavern network beneath Orgrimmar. He is among fellow dark practitioners, away from the city's main thoroughfares.

faq.q: Why are warlocks hidden in the Cleft of Shadow?
faq.answer: Warlocks practice in the Cleft of Shadow because Warchief Thrall and the new Horde's shamanistic society distrust fel magic and demonic corruption after the orcs' past enslavement. The Horde permits warlocks for their utility, but keeps their practice in the shadows to prevent civic unrest.

faq.q: What demons does Gan'rul help summon?
faq.answer: Gan'rul guides warlocks in rituals to summon and subjugate voidwalkers and succubi. Completing his tasks proves a summoner has the will to control these fiends.

faq.q: Does Gan'rul have any known family?
faq.answer: Gan'rul shares a surname with Halga Bloodeye, but their precise relationship is not openly documented.

faq.q: Who is Strahad, whom Gan'rul mentions?
faq.answer: Strahad Farsan is an accomplished warlock living in the Barrens near the Ratchet hills. Gan'rul sends promising students to him for more advanced instruction and greater challenges.

angles.text: As a warlock seeking forbidden knowledge, you can learn from Gan'rul in Kalimdor and face the trials needed to bind voidwalkers and succubi.
As a member of the Horde, you see how fel magic is used for military strength while its practitioners remain confined to the capital's underground recesses.
